slides.text: Borkena, citing DW, reports **Moyale** residents say gunfire resumed **hours after recent peace talks**, and **relief is scarce** on Ethiopia's side.
Christian Today reports **Britain condemns all violence against civilians** in Ethiopia's **Oromia** and backs the rights commission's ability to **investigate**.
Wazema: PM adviser **Getachew Reda** says Ethiopia's **Sudan dialogue call**, rejected by Sudan's government, was **not meant to co-opt** political actors.

slides.title: Back tomorrow at 11 PM.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
